name: search_mathlib
description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

name: read_mathlib
description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

name: search_external_sources
description: Follow source-retrieval.md: arxiv first (default; an exact arXiv ID is allowed), then google title/author search, then google title/author DOI search, then scihub with a confirmed DOI. Use browser:true for normal local-browser readback of JavaScript/verification pages. Results and DOI strings are locators, not source/theorem approval. Record failed access and continue conditionally when the original stays unavailable.

name: read_external_source
description: Read and retain a public HTTPS source and its hash-bound access record. Use offset to continue cached text. Retry with browser:true for a normal isolated local Chrome session if HTTPS needs JavaScript or verification. The optional browser uses ordinary site controls; unsupported challenges remain explicit failures. Verify full PDF identity, version, theorem and context yourself.

name: defer_primary_source
description: After actual unavailable primary-source access, preserve a complete exact secondary quotation as an explicitly unverified external assumption. The statement must match the quote in a supplied input. Returns the verification record for E.source.verification; this never grants ordinary Audit A PASS.

name: read_task_input
description: Read one declared frozen document. For JSON use pointer (empty string lists the root); large objects return keys, and strings resume with offset=next_offset. For text use inclusive start/end lines and column=next_column when continuing a long line. Every serialized result is at most 32 KiB. Follow has_more and the returned continuation coordinates; no arbitrary local files are accessible.

name: read_yui
description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

name: check_artifact
description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

name: submit_artifact
description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

name: report_obstacle
description: Report only a real substantive/suspected mathematical GAP, unavailable source or conflicting original input, with all five located fields. Ordinary unfinished NL0, source registration and JSON bookkeeping are not reports: continue an actual lookup or draft edit. TASK_INCOMPLETE is unavailable for NL0 authoring. Difficulty or a long run is not evidence of a mathematical gap.

name: check_draft
description: Preferred structured-object form of check_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

name: submit_draft
description: Preferred structured-object form of submit_artifact: provide artifact as an actual JSON object, not an escaped JSON string. Same complete validation and acceptance scope.

name: probe_library
description: Query a proved Mathlib theorem and its exact signature/axioms in the offline sandbox. Returns located evidence for an M source; the mathematical statement and applicability still require review. The optional module locator uses dotted syntax (Mathlib.Topology.Basic), never a slash path; omit it if unknown.

name: find_library_sources
description: Search pinned foundational metadata by an exact declaration name or ordinary mathematical terms. Ranked lexical candidates are not a theorem whitelist or an applicability judgment. Selected sources still need explicit M roots and complete checks.

name: read_draft
description: Read a JSON pointer in your own same-stage candidate after an actual structural check. No other file/stage is accessible. For an existing string optionally supply both start_line/end_line to request up to 250 numbered lines and its complete text_sha256 for replace_lines. A read end beyond the text returns the remaining existing lines and actual range; the start must exist. Edits never clamp their range.

name: read_author_packet
description: Same-author closing inspection of one structurally valid own conditional inference: exact direct inputs, output, declarations and own proof. No ancestor bodies, extra H, independent reviewer or Audit A feedback.

name: record_author_checks
description: Save actual same-author notes and readiness against shared Audit A criteria. Unresolved/not-checked partial notes can be saved, but only complete actual packet inspection with no known issue can release a proof. Open issues persist until explicit located resolutions. No PASS or mathematical verdict is generated; independent Audit A receives none of these notes.
